newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - June 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - June 17.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- Signed article recalls Deng Xiaoping's contribution on return of Hong Kong
CHINA SECURITIES
- China fixed asset investment up 15 percent in January-April
- Tibet Mining Development Co to issue 35 million A shares on June 18
- China natural rubber market seen sluggish for rest of 1997
FINANCIAL NEWS
- Central bank vice governor Yin Jieyan calls for banking sector to boost crackdown on fraud, robbery and other crimes
- China banks launch treasury bill trading on interbank market
ECONOMIC INFORMATION DAILY
- China to strictly control rare earth projects
- Shanghai mulls cooperation with Hong Kong after July 1, aims to become international financial centre
FINANCIAL MORNING POST
- Central Bank governor Dai Xianglong urges bank officials to learn from experience of Hong Kong counterparts
ECONOMIC DAILY
- Anhui province wheat output seen at 9.15 million tonnes in 1997
CHINA DAILY
- Beijing officials vow best welcome home party ever for return of Hong Kong
- China indignant over Japanese landing on Diaoyu islands
- Archeologists dig up 2,000 year old mint
- Output of non-ferrous metals up 4.3 percent year-on-year in first four months.
